system.description:
FREE BENEFITS
  • increased maximum Hit Points
  • martial melee proficiency
  • martial armor proficiency

(Printed FREE BENEFITS, listed for reference — inert under the no-innate-benefits rule. Benefits come from the creation benefit-pick pool; see rippers-guise. Adopted from Project FU's Fury counterpart.)

FURY SKILLS

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000127]{Adrenaline} 【Max SL 5】

While in Crisis, +(SL × 2) damage — attacks, spells, Arcana, items, anything.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000128]{Frenzy} 【Max SL 1】

Accuracy Checks with brawling, dagger, flail and thrown weapons crit on doubles (when not a fumble). Two adopted alternates exist — Brave Brawler and Meteor Slam (SL3 caps); take at most one, chosen permanently.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000129]{Indomitable Spirit} 【Max SL 4】

When you spend a Fabula Point to invoke a Bond or Trait: recover (SL × 5) HP, or (SL × 5) MP, or shake one status effect.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000130]{Provoke} 【Max SL 5】

Action + 5 MP: Opposed (MIG + WLP) Check (+SL) against an enemy you can see. Success: they are enraged, fixed on you, and must include you in their attacks and offensive spells while it lasts.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000131]{Withstand} 【Max SL 5】

Guarding without covering anyone: recover (5 + SL × your highest Bond strength) HP, and raise Might or Willpower one die size (max d12) until your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000132]{Raise Hell} 【Max SL 4】

When you cause mayhem to draw attention, up to (SL) other characters each generate an opportunity — plus one once-per-session pick: 1 Fabula Point, a worthy NPC appears, or someone looking to hire you.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000133]{Up Close and Personal} 【Max SL 3】

Get in someone's face to Study them with (MIG + MIG), and ask the GM up to (SL) questions about their motivations, connections or fighting style — answered truthfully.
